rules: Document tree identifiers and references must be consistent.
Variable aliases, modes and bindings must resolve with compatible types.
Component, instance and variant references must be valid and acyclic.
Images are base64 image data URLs indexed by SHA-256-shaped keys.
Additional bounds, migration and cross-field rules are enforced by the bundled parser.
source: MODEL.ts and parser.mjs; run validate.mjs for authoritative validation
